steps.en: Install the CLI and start the local stack (Router, Envoy, Dashboard)
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，拉起本地整套（Router、Envoy、控制台）

steps.en: Register your model endpoints and write decisions: which signal sends a request to which model
steps.zh: 登记模型端点，写决策：哪种信号的请求交给哪个模型

steps.en: Point clients at the routed listener and ask for the virtual model
steps.zh: 客户端改连路由入口，模型名填虚拟模型

steps.en: Envoy hands each request to the Router over ExtProc before forwarding it
steps.zh: Envoy 转发前先把每个请求经 ExtProc 交给 Router

steps.en: Computes signals — domain, jailbreak, PII, keywords, context length — with local classifiers
steps.zh: 用本地小分类器算信号：领域、越狱、PII、关键词、上下文长度

steps.en: Matches the highest-priority decision, picks a model and runs that route's plugins
steps.zh: 命中优先级最高的决策，选出模型，跑这条路由的插件

steps.en: Envoy sends the request to the chosen backend; the choice is written to a header
steps.zh: Envoy 把请求发给选中的后端，选择结果写进响应头

value.en: Apps keep calling one model name — which model serves what, and what gets blocked, lives in one reviewable YAML
value.zh: 应用只认一个模型名；谁来答、什么该拦，都收在一份可审的 YAML 里，不再写进业务代码
